cover.main: A SIGN YOU'RE THE FRIEND WHO SAYS

photo.prompt: five stylish friends outside a Brickell rooftop elevator at 1:40am, one woman holding the door open and laughing while everyone else checks their phones, neon skyline lights, glossy lobby floor, chaotic Miami night out

slides.headline: You Call A Rooftop Reset
slides.body: Everyone says they’re tired. You say Sugar is 8 minutes away and suddenly nobody is tired.

photo.prompt: a confident woman in a black going-out top pointing toward the Brickell skyline while four friends pile into a rideshare outside a downtown Miami bar, city lights, late night excitement

slides.headline: You Read NEAR Before The Next Move
slides.body: You see two friends at a Wynwood bar nearby and now the group has a full itinerary again.

photo.prompt: a group of friends huddled around a phone showing a nightlife app outside a colorful Wynwood bar line, murals behind them, neon sign glow, midnight Miami street scene

slides.headline: You Treat The Line Like A Meetup
slides.body: The South Beach wait turns into selfies, gossip, and three new people joining your plans.

photo.prompt: five friends laughing in a velvet rope line outside a South Beach club, one friend taking a wide angle selfie, palm trees and pink neon lighting, busy but glamorous Miami night

slides.headline: You Hear The DJ Switch And Stay
slides.body: One song fixes your whole group. Suddenly leaving sounds dramatic and unnecessary.

photo.prompt: a packed Miami club dance floor at 2am, a woman grabbing her friend's hand as the DJ changes songs, blue and purple lights, confetti in the air, everyone smiling

slides.headline: You Promise Cafecito After
slides.body: Your exit strategy is Cuban coffee, pastelitos, and acting normal at the beach tomorrow.

photo.prompt: four friends in going-out outfits at a bright Cuban coffee window in Little Havana at 3:30am, cafecitos and pastelitos on the counter, warm streetlights, funny tired smiles

caption: tag the friend who turns “we’re leaving” into one more stop 😂
